//: Scene lengths in frames at 30 fps, per cut. The fades overlap their neighbours, so a cut runs for the sum of its scenes less one fade per join. Each scene is written at the 60-second cut's length; a shorter cut plays it faster rather than cutting it off. music/make_music.py reads this file too, so the score follows the picture. The montage runs at the same length in every cut, because its shots are cut on the beat.
